name: Pickset – Product Options & Product Addons for WooCommerce
author: pluginshift

sections.description:
Pickset Product Options lets you add extra product options, product addons and custom fields to any WooCommerce product. Build reusable option sets with a visual drag-and-drop builder, assign them to the products that need them, and let customers personalise what they buy while the price updates live.

Swatches, file uploads, date and time pickers, formula-based pricing, conditional logic and linked add-on products are all included. Every choice flows through to the cart, checkout and order, so you and your customers always see exactly what was ordered.

Pickset Product Options is 100% free. There is no paid version, no license key, no locked features and no upsell notices. Every feature described on this page is available the moment you activate the plugin.

Who is it for?

WooCommerce variations are great for a handful of fixed choices, but they cannot collect a customer’s name for engraving, a design file for printing, or a delivery date. Pickset Product Options fills that gap. It is a good fit for:

  • Print on demand and custom apparel: let shoppers upload artwork, pick a print position and add a name to a t-shirt, mug or poster.
  • Personalised gifts: collect engraving text, gift messages and wrapping choices, and charge per character or per word.
  • Food and restaurant ordering: build a pizza or meal configurator with toppings, sizes and extras that each add to the price.
  • Made-to-measure products: calculate the price of curtains, signs or fabric from customer-entered dimensions using a formula.
  • Services and appointments: ask for a preferred date and time, block unavailable days, and gather contact details.
  • Upsells and cross-sells: offer related products, such as a case with a phone or batteries with a toy, as add-ons that join the cart as their own line items.

Key features

  • Visual option set builder: drag and drop fields onto a live canvas, then edit every setting in a side panel with an instant preview.
  • 30 custom product field types: text inputs, choices, swatches, uploads, pickers, formulas and layout elements.
  • Dynamic pricing: fixed, percentage, per unit, per character, per word and formula-based prices, with a separate regular and sale price for every choice.
  • Conditional logic: show or hide any field based on other answers, matching all or any of your rules.
  • Flexible assignment: show an option set on all products, specific products, product categories, tags or brands, and exclude individual products.
  • Full WooCommerce integration: selections are validated, priced, and saved to the cart, checkout and order.
  • Variable product support: option prices follow the selected variation automatically.
  • Global styles: match your theme with eight ready-made color presets.
  • Built-in analytics: see impressions, clicks, add-to-cart rate, completed sales and revenue for each option set.
  • Multi-currency compatible: works with 14 popular WooCommerce currency switchers.
  • Modern and compatible: supports High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS) and the WooCommerce Cart and Checkout blocks.

30 custom product field types

Input fields

  • Text and Textarea: collect names, engraving text, notes and instructions, with minimum and maximum length.
  • Email, URL and Phone: validated contact fields. The phone field offers a country flag, dial code and a default country.
  • Number: accept quantities, measurements or any numeric value.
  • Date, Time and Date & Time: choose from six date formats and 12 or 24-hour time, set the earliest and latest selectable values, and block specific dates, weekdays or days of the month.
  • File Upload: drag-and-drop uploads with your own allowed file types, maximum file size, minimum and maximum number of files, and custom messages.

Choice fields

  • Checkboxes, Radio Buttons, Dropdown, Toggle and Button Group: classic choice fields, each with its own price.
  • Color Swatch and Image Swatch: visual choices. Image swatches can switch the main product image when selected.
  • Range Slider: let customers pick a value within a range.
  • Color Picker: accept any custom color.
  • Font Picker: let customers choose a font, including your own uploaded web fonts.
  • Linked Products: add other products, or specific variations, as optional add-ons with their own quantity.

Choice fields support per-option quantities, minimum and maximum selections, and multiple selections.

Advanced fields

  • Formula: calculate a price from other field values with arithmetic and functions such as min, max, round, ceil, floor, abs, pow and if.
  • Advanced Formula: build more complex pricing rules across several fields.

Layout fields

  • Heading, HTML, Divider and Spacer: structure the form and add helpful content.
  • Section: group fields into a section or a collapsible accordion that starts open or closed.
  • Popup: add a button that opens a popup, such as a size guide, built with text, images, links and tables.
  • Shortcode: place the output of any shortcode inside your product options.

Dynamic pricing for product addons

Every choice can change the final product price, and customers see the updated total before they add to cart.

  • Fixed: add a set amount.
  • Percentage: add a percentage of the product price, following the selected variation.
  • Per unit: multiply by the chosen quantity.
  • Per character and per character (no spaces): ideal for engraving and embroidery.
  • Per word: ideal for printed messages.
  • Formula: calculate the price from any combination of field values.

Each choice has both a regular and a sale price. Prices respect your WooCommerce tax settings, and the price is always recalculated on the server, so the amount charged cannot be changed from the browser.

You decide what shoppers see on the product page: show or hide an “options price” line and a “total price” line, each with its own label.

Conditional logic

Keep product pages short and relevant. Show a field only when it matters, for example a “Gift message” box that appears after the shopper ticks “This is a gift”. Rules support is, is not, contains, does not contain, starts with, is empty, is not empty, is checked, greater than, less than and between, and you can require all rules or any rule to match.

Assign options to the right products

Create an option set once and reuse it across your catalog. Show it on:

  • all products in your store
  • specific products
  • one or more product categories
  • product tags
  • product brands

Exclude individual products from any assignment. On the product edit screen, a Product Options tab lists the option sets that apply to that product.

Seamless WooCommerce cart, checkout and orders

  • Required fields are validated before a product can be added to the cart.
  • Selected options appear in the cart, mini cart, checkout and order details.
  • Linked products are added to the cart as their own line items.
  • Choose whether options are shown or hidden on the cart and checkout pages.
  • Optionally replace “Add to cart” on shop and category pages with a “Select options” button, so customers configure the product before buying.

File uploads with automatic cleanup

Customer uploads are stored in their own folder and moved along as each order progresses. You choose how long files are kept at each stage (temporary uploads, after the order is placed, and after the order is completed), and a scheduled task removes expired files automatically, so your server does not fill up with abandoned uploads.

Built-in analytics

Find out which option sets help you sell. The analytics dashboard shows impressions, clicks, click-through rate, add-to-cart rate, completed sales, checkout rate, revenue and overall conversion rate, with a daily trend chart. All data is stored in your own database.

Multi-currency compatible

Option prices are converted correctly when your store uses a currency switcher. Pickset Product Options is compatible with 14 popular solutions, including WooPayments multi-currency, WPML WooCommerce Multilingual & Multicurrency, CURCY, YayCurrency, FOX Currency Switcher (WOOCS), Aelia Currency Switcher, YITH Multi Currency Switcher and Price Based on Country.

Fast, private and secure

  • Storefront scripts and styles load only on products that have option sets.
  • No external requests, no tracking and no data collection of any kind.
  • Every setting is saved with WordPress nonces and capability checks.
  • Uploaded files are validated by type and size, and SVG files are blocked by default.
  • Fully translation-ready.
sections.installation:
Minimum requirements

  • WordPress 6.2 or later
  • WooCommerce 7.0 or later
  • PHP 7.4 or later

Automatic installation

  1. In your WordPress dashboard, go to Plugins > Add New Plugin.
  2. Search for Pickset Product Options.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.

Manual installation

  1. Download the plugin zip file.
  2. Go to Plugins > Add New Plugin > Upload Plugin and choose the zip file.
  3. Click Install Now, then Activate.

You can also unzip the file and upload the pickset-product-options folder to /wp-content/plugins/ over FTP, then activate it from the Plugins screen.

Create your first option set

  1. Go to Product Options > Option Sets in your dashboard.
  2. Create a new option set and drag fields onto the canvas.
  3. Set prices and conditional logic for each field.
  4. Click Assign and choose the products, categories, tags or brands that should display it.
  5. Publish the option set and open one of those products in your store.
sections.faq:
Is Pickset Product Options really free?

Yes. There is no premium version, no license key and no locked features. All 30 field types, both formula fields, conditional logic, analytics and multi-currency compatibility are included for free.

Does it require WooCommerce?

Yes. Pickset Product Options is a WooCommerce extension, so WooCommerce 7.0 or later must be installed and active.

How is this different from WooCommerce variations?

Variations are best for combinations of fixed attributes, such as size and color, that each have their own stock. Product options are better for input that cannot be listed in advance, such as custom text, uploaded files, dates or calculated measurements, and for extras that add to the price without creating a new variation.

Can I add extra product options to specific products or categories?

Yes. Each option set can be assigned to all products, specific products, product categories, product tags or product brands, and you can exclude individual products.

Does it work with variable products?

Yes. Option prices, including percentage-based prices, update automatically when the customer selects a variation.

Can product options change the price?

Yes. Every choice can add a fixed amount, a percentage, a per unit, per character or per word price, or a formula-based price, with separate regular and sale prices. The final price is always recalculated on the server.

Can customers upload files?

Yes. The File Upload field accepts images (PNG, JPG and HEIC), PDF, CSV, DOC and plain text files by default, and you can control the allowed types, maximum size and number of files. SVG files are blocked by default because they can contain scripts. Developers who accept that risk can allow them with the pkset_upload_mimes filter.

Where are uploaded files stored, and are they deleted?

Files are stored in wp-content/uploads/pkset_uploads/. You choose how long they are kept at each order stage, and expired files are removed automatically by a scheduled task.

Does it work with the WooCommerce Cart and Checkout blocks?

Yes. Pickset Product Options supports both the Cart and Checkout blocks and the classic shortcode-based pages. It is also compatible with High-Performance Order Storage (HPOS).

Will it slow down my store?

No. The storefront scripts and styles load only on products that have an option set, and the admin builder loads only on the plugin’s own screens.

Does it work with multi-currency plugins?

Yes. It is compatible with 14 popular currency switchers, including WooPayments, WPML, CURCY, YayCurrency, FOX (WOOCS), Aelia, YITH and Price Based on Country.

Do I need to know how to code?

No. Everything is built with the visual drag-and-drop builder. Developers can still extend the plugin with WordPress actions and filters.

Does the plugin collect data or connect to external services?

No. Pickset Product Options makes no external requests and does not track you or your customers. Analytics data is stored only in your own WordPress database.

Is it translation-ready?

Yes. All text uses the pickset-product-options text domain, and a translation template is included in the languages folder.
